context.transcript:
Welcome to Mickleton Bicycle Tours, everybody.
My name is Jane, and I'll be leading your afternoon ride.
Seeing the city by bicycle is a fun and unique way to experience the area.
But before we go on the tour, there are a couple things you need to do.
First, everyone should go pick out a bike from our main building.
Our staff is available to help you select one that will be comfortable for your ride today.
And be sure to pick up a helmet at the same time.
Oh, and remember, you don't need to bring any food.
We'll be handing out snacks throughout the afternoon.
context.transcript_translation:
欢迎来到 Mickleton Bicycle Tours，各位。
我叫 Jane，我将带领大家进行下午的骑行。
骑自行车游览这座城市是一种有趣而独特的体验方式。
但在我们开始行程之前，有几件事需要你们做。
首先，每个人都应该到我们的主楼去挑选一辆自行车。
我们的工作人员可以帮助您选择一套适合您今天骑行的自行车。
同时也要记得领取一个头盔。
哦，还有，请记住，您不需要带任何食物。
我们会在整个下午分发零食的。
